top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a complete, bounded discovery arc: Holst's incretin physiology and GLP-1 secretion and action in humans, Drucker's proglucagon, receptor and tissue biology, and Mojsov's identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide. It is matured by replicated randomised outcome data in glycaemia, weight and cardiovascular and renal endpoints, and it changed the field. The three-laureate allocation and citation scope are defensible, so awarding is clearly preferable to no award.
